cooked: For mempool policy, committee rotation shouldn’t change transaction validity; keep consensus rules separate from each node’s relay thresholds, and have wallets re-evaluate inputs against the newly finalized UTXO set. For proof throughput, benchmark parsing, range-proof verification, and state updates separately before tuning cache behavior. If batching uses randomized coefficients, make sure consensus-critical acceptance cannot depend on node-local randomness.
